title: cyclosorus canlaonensis
intro: Cyclosorus canlaonensis, commonly known as the Canlaon fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Cyclosorus canlaonensis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing pain, inflammation, and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial actions due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
